hostedSubset.reasonMediaNotMirrored: The official media remains upstream because duplicating 188 videos would exceed the remaining GitHub Pages publication budget.
hostedSubset.intendedUse: Stimulus selection and clip-level convergent validation of induced valence and arousal.
hostedSubset.qualificationBoundary: OpenLAV supplies post-clip induced-affect ratings. A concatenated sequence is not a pre-validated continuous ten-minute stimulus.

ratingSemantics.clipNormColumns: Published valence/arousal factor-score summaries; preserve exactly and consult the codebook.
ratingSemantics.affectTrackerTransform: No transform is applied in this archive. If raw SAM items are analysed on [-1,1], pre-register (SAM - 5) / 4.

ratingsNotice: The public-use raw file retains publisher-issued HIT/worker identifiers, age, gender, education, personality, and questionnaire fields. Prefer aggregate norms; restrict row-level use to justified research processing and do not attempt re-identification.
